CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  April 14, 2026

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman; Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Michael
  Daninger; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Stanley Tsai; Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect

  Staff Present: Eric Martinez, City Architect Representative

C.  ELECTION OF OFFICERS FOR 2026-2027
  Nomination and election of Chairman, Vice Chairman, and Secretary of the Design Review
  Board for 2026-2027, in accordance with AMC 2.27.060.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to nominate and approve the City Architect as the Secretary
  of the Design Review Board.
  •  Moved by Vice Chairman Udani, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Yes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Ng
  No:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to nominate and approve Nora Hernandez as the Chairman
  of the Design Review Board.
  •  Moved by Vice Chairman Udani, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Yes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Ng
  No:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – March 10, 2026
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the March 10, 2026, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the March 10, 2026, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  MINUTES – March 24, 2026
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the March 24, 2026, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the March 24, 2026, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve all Consent Agenda Items.
  •  Moved by Vice Chair Udani, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-016
  • 701 West Hellman Avenue
  • Applicant: Krystina Tsengs

  2
  04/14/2026
   •  Request: This is an application for the replacement of five (5)
  windows on an existing 1-story single-family residence.
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Provide a note on the plans indicating that all window trim
  shall be a width of 2” at the top and sides of the window, and
  3” at the bottom. The bottom trim shall extend horizontally
  beyond the adjacent side trims.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-026
  • 116 West Main Street
  • Applicant: John Estrada
  • Request: This is an application for new signage on an existing
  commercial building for a new individual business tenant known as
  “Pinecone Bakery.”
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Provide further clarification on location of the proposed blade
  sign as it pertains to the front elevation.

  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Vice Chairman
  Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

 AGENDA
ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-135
  • 1902 West Grand Avenue
  • Applicant: Steve Sudduth & Jennifer Cole
  • Request: This is an application for exterior alterations to an existing
  2-story single-family residence, including the removal and
  replacement of exterior wall siding.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The proposed plank width shall be clearly identified on the
  product brochure included in this submittal package. The
  selected plank width shall be no less than 6.25”.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The proposed plank width shall be clearly identified on the
  product brochure included in this submittal package. The
  selected plank width shall be no less than 8.25” and no more
  than 9.25”. The applicant to work with city staff on selecting a
  plank width that closely resembles the existing size.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

AGENDA

  adjacent to a current parking area at the rear of the lot.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
